BETWEEN:-
 AKASH S/O SHRI BANSILAL BHAVEL, AGED 23 YEARS,
 OCCUPATION: STUDENT 369 A, VIDUR NAGAR  DWARKAPURI, INDORE (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI VALMIK SAKARGAYEN - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH STATION  HOUSE OFFICER POLICE STATION CRIME BRANCH,
 INDORE (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 ( SHRI VISHAL SANOTHIYA - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE FOR STATE)
 ( SHRI PANKAJ TAKNET - ADVOCATE FOR OBJECTOR)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 14/2023 registered at Police Station Crime Branch Indore District Indore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420 and 409 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text: Police Station Crime Branch Indore District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The applicant is in custody since 25.3.2023.
2.

As per prosecution story, a complaint was made against the applicant alleging that the applicant has influence the complainants for making investment in share market and cryptocurrency for making profit and further influence them to invest more money to get unimaginable profit.
Believing upon the applicant, the complainants invested huge amount for good returns as assured by present applicant.

Later on the present applicant refused to return the money of complainants,
The complainants lodged a report at crime branch Indore against the applicant.
Accordingly, offence has been registered against the applicant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is an innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this offence.
He is in custody since 25.3.2023.

Only Palkesh has submitted two receipts of Rs. 1 lakh and Rs. 50 thousand and as per their own statements, the said amount has already been returned to the complainant named Palkesh nor there is any documentary evidence or allegation in the charge sheet in this regard.
The applicant is permanent resident of Indore District.

Under the above circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.
4.
Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State as well as objector opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.

5. Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.
6.

After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence,
arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant, it is revealed that bank account is in the name of present applicant and huge amount has been invested by investors, the applicant did not register his firm under SEBI or any other competent agency.

Therefore, in view of the bank accounts and other documents it would be appropriate that applicant to be directed to deposit 50%
of the amount in question (i.e. Rs. 62,18,800/-) before the trial court.

7. At this stage counsel for applicant seeks permission to withdraw this M.Cr.C.
8.
This M.Cr.C. is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn.
Certified copy as per rules.
(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE BDJ Akash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109909372/
